conditions.fixture: Unmodified captured baseline src/include/tests/docs, never generated source
conditions.cache: OS cache uncontrolled; explicit warmups; NOT cold-cache
conditions.timing: Fresh CLI process; target startup/shutdown included, Python helper startup excluded
conditions.ordering: Deterministically shuffled tool order within each paired repetition
conditions.comparison: RS count-only vs rg complete count scans; result-set correctness checked separately
conditions.regex_counts: Matching lines: RS one match per line, ripgrep --count (not --count-matches)
conditions.term_counts: Exact RS tokens; rg -w -F equivalence verified on this fixture, not universal Unicode claim
conditions.correctness: Independent Python per-file counts + rg; old/new ordered full hits on each SAME index
conditions.cpu: POSIX target process CPU via isolated helper; unavailable on Windows
conditions.rss: POSIX child high-water, may include inherited Python pre-exec floor; unavailable on Windows
conditions.small_corpus_caveat: Startup, scheduling and timer noise can dominate; 21-sample nearest-rank p95 is coarse
conditions.coverage: One real source tree only; this is not evidence for every language, repository or platform
conditions.build: Separate create samples, never included in query latency; few repetitions are not stable p95 evidence
